findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed facility to have no sanitizer bucket set up during inspection. (CORRECTED) Discussed with PIC, and PIC mixed a sanitizer bucket at 400PPM of quaternary ammonium sanitizer. Ensure that kitchen staff have access to a prepared sanitizer bucket whenever food preparation is taking place.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
An employee was observed using bare hands to turn off faucet handles after the handwashing process. Discussed with PIC proper handwashing techniques. Ensure that employees use barriers to turn off faucet handles after the handwashing process to avoid recontaminating hands.  

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
There wasn’t any paper towels at the hand-sink in the kitchen area. Discussed with PIC and paper-towels were provided to the dispenser. Be sure that paper towels are available at every handsink to ensure that hands are getting washed properly.   

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
Observed a container of uncovered ice to be stored on a table in the serving area. The ice container is used for residents to serve themselves.  PIC noted that the facility will be getting a table top ice dispenser in the near future. Ensure that the container of ice is covered or served by employees to protect against contamination.

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the can opener to be accumulated with food debris. Discussed with PIC and can opener was cleaned and sanitized. Ensure that can openers are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent contaminating food. 

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.
